phases.message: It's open enrollment and I'm doing Mom and Dad's drug plans. Start in Dr. Osei's portal: what they each really take now, and her notes.
Corner Pharmacy. See what they each fill, how often, and how it gets to them.
Rxmeadow, their plan now. Read what changes for 2027.

PlanCompass. Compare the 2027 plans for each of them on their real drugs at the pharmacy they really use, and enroll each in the plan that costs them least for the year, premium and drugs together, if that isn't the plan they have. Then tell me what you left alone and why.

anoc.text: Today is Monday 2 November 2026. Rxmeadow Basic Rx, Annual Notice of Change for 2027, sent 24 September 2026. Sections: costs, pharmacies, drugs. If you do nothing, you stay in Rxmeadow Basic Rx in 2027.
2027: premium $38 a month (2026: $31). Deductible $700 on tiers 3 to 5 (2026: $615).
From 1 January 2027 Corner Pharmacy is a standard network pharmacy, no longer preferred; ValueMart stays preferred. Standard pharmacies cost more per fill.
All of Rosa's and Henrik's current drugs stay on the 2027 formulary at the same tiers; none needs prior authorization.

plan_terms.text: Today is Monday 2 November 2026. PlanCompass compares 2027 Medicare drug plans (Part D) for Rosa and Henrik Lindqvist. Plans: RX Rxmeadow Basic Rx (their plan now), BP Brightpath Rx Saver, NS Northstar Value Rx, KP Keystone Plus Rx. Ask for a plan id for its terms. Every figure on the formulary pages is the plan's own 2027 cost for 12 fills at Corner Pharmacy, the deductible included; a drug's cost counts toward the year's out-of-pocket limit only when the plan covers it.
Rxmeadow Basic Rx, 2027. Premium $38 a month. Deductible $700, on tiers 3 to 5. Corner Pharmacy: in network, standard (no longer preferred from 1 January 2027). Preferred pharmacies: ValueMart.

Brightpath Rx Saver, 2027. Premium $4.20 a month, the lowest in the area. Deductible $0. Network: ValueMart and Harbor Drug only; Corner Pharmacy is out of network. Out-of-network fills are not covered except when a member cannot reasonably use a network pharmacy and does not use one routinely: the member pays the full cash price, which does not count toward the out-of-pocket limit.

Northstar Value Rx, 2027. Premium $26 a month. Deductible $350, on tiers 3 to 5. Corner Pharmacy: in network, preferred. Prior authorization on some drugs: the prescriber shows the plan's criteria are met. A new member gets a one-time temporary 30-day supply of a drug that needs prior authorization in the first 90 days.
Keystone Plus Rx, 2027. Premium $79 a month. Deductible $0. Corner Pharmacy: in network, preferred.

Medicare's annual election period runs from 15 October to 7 December (42 CFR 423.38(b)); a plan chosen in it starts on 1 January 2027 (423.40). Enrolling in a new drug plan ends the old one on the day the new one starts; there is nothing to cancel (423.32(e)). Each plan sets its own formulary, tiers, prior authorization and step rules, network and preferred pharmacies, premium and deductible. For 2027, a plan's deductible is at most $700, and once a member's out-of-pocket spending on covered drugs reaches $2,400, the plan pays the rest for the year.
